Now additionally the stable coin supply on PolygonMatic ended in December, as you can see on this chart, at a notable decrease. These efforts have focused on synthesizing the two primary approaches to block chain design, modular and integrated architectures. But looking at Polygon Matic today, answering the question, is this ecosystem dead? The answer is a very simple no. Look at Poly Market. Look at the prediction markets that have caused billions upon billions of dollars to be transacted on the overall network. Ecosystems and partnerships are growing and while 2024 I would argue was yes brutal the rebrand on Polygonmatic I'm being honest with you guys was terrible. Rebranding is always insanely difficult and there is very few success stories of an overall rebrand that just changes the overall landscape of a project.
